content:
Looking for new games for your iPhone and iPad? The App Store offers an overwhelming number of choices, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service suitable for all ages, but it is not the only option. If you are already a Netflix subscriber, you can actually access many excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a large number of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan now includes a vast library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest "Standard with Ads" plan at only US$8.99 per month (approximately HK$70).

Regardless of which Netflix plan you choose, you can already enjoy mobile and TV games with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers an app designed specifically for iPhone and iPad, named Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller to use with supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, purchasing a dedicated iPhone game controller is a good choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app named Netflix Playground, which contains mini-games designed for children. In addition, there are 《Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games》 (no subscription required) and 《Netflix Stories》.

Beyond the games above, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then log in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
